_readme: Add your Instagram session cookies here.
Each entry = one Instagram account. Rotate cookies to handle 200-1000 downloads/day.
1. Open Chrome/Firefox and log into Instagram
2. Press F12 → Application tab → Cookies → https://www.instagram.com
3. Copy: sessionid, ds_user_id, csrftoken, mid, ig_did, datr
Tip: Use 5-10 accounts for 200-1000 downloads/day reliability.
The INSTAGRAM_COOKIES env variable is always used as account #1.
